# LAMMPS input script for quenching SiO2

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SiO2.tersoff Si O

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5

timestep 0.001

# Define the NPT ensemble
fix 1 all npt temp 5000 1500 3.5 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Run the simulation
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density
run 1000000

# Unfix the NPT ensemble
unfix 1

# Load the extracted data
file_path = '/results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_false/level_1/comprehensive/sio2_quenching_1_trial_2/quench_thermo.csv'

# Save the Tg value

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SiO2.tersoff Si O

# Define simulation settings
timestep 0.001

# NPT ensemble for quenching
fix 1 all npt temp 5000 1500 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
